name: Assault Mastery
summary: You can select the assault doctrine one additional time per battle.

name: Mastered Doctrines
summary: Up to 3 times per battle, pick an unused Combat Doctrine until your next Command phase: shoot after Advancing, shoot/charge after falling back, or charge after Advancing. Repeats need Marneus Calgar. Army: Ultramarines only.

name: Mission Tactics
summary: Friendly KILL TEAM units with this ability have: Furor Tactics: if the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, its attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Malleus Tactics: if the tactical doctrine is active, its attacks have [LETHAL HITS]. Purgatus Tactics: if the assault doctrine is active, its attacks targeting an enemy unit within 9" of this unit have [PRECISION]. You can include DEATHWATCH units without your army's Chapter faction keyword, max 500 points combined. Unless otherwise stated, a DEATHWATCH model cannot be your WARLORD. KILL TEAM units take enhancements only from this detachment.

name: Devastator Mastery
summary: You can select the devastator doctrine one additional time per battle.

name: Vulkan’s Quest
summary: Adeptus Astartes ranged weapons gain Assault and add 1 Strength against targets within 12". With Vulkan He'stan in your army, Infernus Squads may start an Action after Advancing or shoot after starting one. Salamanders only.

name: Combined Deployment
summary: In your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Transport unit has shot, you can select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is assailed until the end of the turn. While a unit is assailed, when an Adeptus Astartes unit that disembarked this turn targets that unit, those attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

name: Codex Discipline
summary: You can select one combat doctrine one additional time per battle.

name: Combat Doctrines
summary: At the start of your Command phase, you can select one of the Combat Doctrines below. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Doctrine is active and its effects apply to all ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army. Each Combat Doctrine can only be selected once per battle. Devastator Doctrine: this unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced. Tactical Doctrine: this unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. Assault Doctrine: this unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

name: Walking Fortress
summary: In a turn in which a friendly Gravis unit made a Normal move, that unit's ranged attacks do not have [Heavy] and have +1 to hit rolls.

name: Indomitable Defence
summary: While a friendly Gravis unit is within range of an objective, attacks that target that unit with a Strength characteristic greater than that unit's Toughness characteristic have -1 to wound rolls.

name: Enduring Vengeance
summary: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Dreadnought units can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

name: Armoured Wrath
summary: Once per phase, each Adeptus Astartes unit in your army may re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll or one Damage roll made for a model in that unit.

name: Ironstorm Auto-targeters
summary: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle units, excluding Walker units, can re-roll one hit roll and re-roll one wound roll when making ranged attacks.

name: Armoured Wrath
summary: Each time a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot or selected to fight, apply one of the following when resolving those attacks: if that unit is within 6" of a friendly Cannok Var/Iron Father Feirros unit, you can: re-roll one hit roll; re-roll one wound roll; re-roll one damage roll. Otherwise you can: re-roll one hit roll; or re-roll one wound roll; or re-roll one damage roll.

name: Shadow Masters
summary: When a friendly Phobos or Scout SQUAD unit has shot, choose one of the following: those attacks do not prevent that unit from being hidden; or that unit can make a normal move of up to D6", and that unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

name: Vanguard Ambushers
summary: At the end of your Movement phase, if a friendly Phobos unit is hidden, that unit's attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1 until the end of the turn.

name: Masters of Shadow
summary: A ranged attack against an Adeptus Astartes unit from beyond 12 inches gives that unit Benefit of Cover.

name: Restrictions
summary: Army composition restriction: the army may include Raven Guard units, but may not include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

name: Shadow Tactics
summary: Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units have Stealth. Friendly Phobos/Scout Squad units have -3" detection range. Friendly Aethon Shaan units gain the ability Unparalleled Tactician: once per battle round, per army, when you use the Into Darkness stratagem, that use is -1CP.

name: Unparalleled Tactician
summary: Once per battle round, if Aethon Shaan is on the battlefield, you can use the Into Darkness Stratagem for 0 Command Points.

name: Restrictions
summary: Army composition restriction: the army may include White Scars units, but may not include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

name: Storm-swift Onslaught
summary: Adeptus Astartes units can declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced or Fell Back.

name: Wrath of the First Khan
summary: At the end of the Fight phase, if a Suboden Khan unit destroyed an enemy unit this phase and isn't engaged, it can make a Normal move of up to 6 inches.

name: Lightning Assault
summary: Adeptus Astartes units can declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced or Fell Back.

name: Lightning-fast Strike
summary: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted and Speeder units have +2" to their Move characteristic.

name: Tactical Mastery
summary: You can select the tactical doctrine one additional time per battle.

name: Wrath of the Chapter
summary: Friendly Tacticus units can re-roll advance rolls.

name: Codex Fire-patterns
summary: Friendly Tacticus units' attacks with the [Rapid Fire] ability benefit from [Rapid Fire] when targeting a unit at any range up to that attack's maximum range.

name: Death Blow
summary: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Terminator units have +1 to charge rolls.
